content_md:
**Blygger protocol 0.4 is published:** [blygger.org/spec/0.4/](https://blygger.org/spec/0.4/), with its first dated snapshot at [/spec/0.4/2026-10-18/](https://blygger.org/spec/0.4/2026-10-18/). 0.3 is superseded and stays citable.

Two constructs ruled earlier are now normative, each built and tested across live blygs first:

- **Remote generation sources** (§5.7, §15.4): a model may draw on another blyg's item, which is disclosed as a source and notifies its origin.
- **The manifest locates the surface** (§4, §6.1): a manifest may say where its feed, items and pins live, which is how WordPress publishes natively.

And the grammar gains an optional **label**: `[[id | text]]`, `![[id | text]]` (§10.1). Blygger Studio supports it from 0.47.0.

A valid 0.3 document is a valid 0.4 document unchanged.
